package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

const (
	TeacherDialogPolicyVersion   = "teacher-dialog-policy-v1"
	DefaultPedagogyMethodCode    = "adaptive"
	ProgressiveHintMethodVersion = "progressive-hint-v1"
)

// PedagogyStage is method-neutral. AMCD is the first registered method family,
// but future methods may define their own bounded stage codes.
type PedagogyStage string

const (
	AMCDCaptivate PedagogyStage = "captivate"
	AMCDOrient    PedagogyStage = "orient"
	AMCDRealize   PedagogyStage = "realize"
	AMCDExecute   PedagogyStage = "execute"
)

type TeacherGuidance string

const (
	TeacherGuidanceSocraticQuestion    TeacherGuidance = "socratic_question"
	TeacherGuidanceDirection           TeacherGuidance = "direction"
	TeacherGuidanceConceptReminder     TeacherGuidance = "concept_reminder"
	TeacherGuidanceAnalogousExample    TeacherGuidance = "analogous_example"
	TeacherGuidancePseudocode          TeacherGuidance = "pseudocode"
	TeacherGuidancePartialStructure    TeacherGuidance = "partial_structure"
	TeacherGuidanceGuidedBreakdown     TeacherGuidance = "guided_breakdown"
	TeacherGuidanceAdaptiveExplanation TeacherGuidance = "adaptive_explanation"
)

// TeacherTeachingPlan is the deterministic authority supplied to the model.
// It contains a business reason, never hidden model reasoning.
type TeacherTeachingPlan struct {
	PolicyVersion         string          `json:"policy_version"`
	MethodCode            string          `json:"method_code"`
	MethodVersion         string          `json:"method_version"`
	TeachingMode          TeachingMode    `json:"teaching_mode"`
	Strategy              string          `json:"strategy"`
	Stage                 PedagogyStage   `json:"stage"`
	Action                TeacherAction   `json:"action"`
	HintLevel             int             `json:"hint_level"`
	Guidance              TeacherGuidance `json:"guidance"`
	AllowCompleteSolution bool            `json:"allow_complete_solution"`
	ReasonCode            string          `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary         string          `json:"reason_summary"`
}

func NewTeacherTeachingPlan(input TeacherTeachingPlan) (TeacherTeachingPlan, error) {
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.MethodCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.MethodCode))
	input.MethodVersion = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.MethodVersion))
	input.Strategy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Strategy))
	input.Stage = PedagogyStage(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.Stage))))
	input.ReasonCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonCode))
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	if input.PolicyVersion != TeacherDialogPolicyVersion || !validValue(input.MethodCode, 64) ||
		!validValue(input.MethodVersion, 64) || !validTeachingMode(input.TeachingMode) ||
		!validValue(input.Strategy, 64) || !validValue(string(input.Stage), 64) ||
		!validTeacherAction(input.Action) || input.HintLevel < 0 || input.HintLevel > 7 ||
		!validTeacherGuidance(input.Guidance) || input.AllowCompleteSolution ||
		!validValue(input.ReasonCode, 128) || !validValue(input.ReasonSummary, 1000) {
		return TeacherTeachingPlan{}, errors.New("invalid teacher teaching plan")
	}
	if input.Action == TeacherActionGiveHint && input.HintLevel < 1 {
		return TeacherTeachingPlan{}, errors.New("hint plan requires a positive level")
	}
	if input.Action != TeacherActionGiveHint && input.HintLevel != 0 {
		return TeacherTeachingPlan{}, errors.New("non-hint plan cannot carry a hint level")
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validTeacherGuidance(value TeacherGuidance) bool {
	switch value {
	case TeacherGuidanceSocraticQuestion, TeacherGuidanceDirection, TeacherGuidanceConceptReminder,
		TeacherGuidanceAnalogousExample, TeacherGuidancePseudocode, TeacherGuidancePartialStructure,
		TeacherGuidanceGuidedBreakdown, TeacherGuidanceAdaptiveExplanation:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
